name: 店員
text: ありがとうございましたー

name: 冬優子
trans:
Fabric for the assignment, and...
... For repairs...

name: 冬優子
trans: Now to go home, and quickly────

name: アニメファン１
text:
おーーー！
『ミラ♡ミラ』じゃん！

name: アニメファン１
text:
いやー、マジで最＆高だわ
書き下ろしポスターとか号泣レベル
trans:
Ahh, the real Greatest of All Time.
Getting a poster with a brand new illustration is 
enough to drive me to tears.

name: アニメファン１
text:
は？　かなり画期的なコンセプトの神アニメなんだが？
魔法とアイドルのモチーフで、ここまで攻めた作品ないから
trans:
Huh? Don't you know it's a masterpiece with
a revolutionary concept? Nothing came close 
to how far it took the motifs of magic and idols.

name: アニメファン１
text:
アイドルが力を合わせて活躍する姿なんか
現代アイドルの理想と言っても過言じゃ────
trans:
The iconic scenes of idols combining their
strengths and performing together, I'd even say
this is the classical ideal that real────

name: アニメファン２
text:
古参ぶんなー
今の作画に負けてるやん
trans:
Drop that veteran act.
It doesn't even hold up to modern animation
standards.

name: アニメファン１
text:
いやいやいや、アニメ史的にもマストだから
不朽の名作がやっと円盤化されたんだから感謝して
trans:
Oh no no, this is a must-watch from an anime
history perspective. Be grateful that this classic
has finally been released on disc.

name: アニメファン２
text:
うるせー
わかったから早く買ってこいって
trans:
Shut up, man.
I get it already, hurry up and buy it.

name: アニメファン１
trans: Nah, I have my own copy.

name: アニメファン２
text:
持ってんのかよ！
それ先に言えよ
trans:
You had it the whole time!?
You should've told me sooner.

name: アニメファン１
text: お前に布教したかっただけ
trans: I just wanted to spread the word to you.

name: アニメファン２
text: いや、いきなりボックスとかハードル高すぎ
trans:
Wait, buying a full box set out of the blue
is way too big a hurdle for me.

name: アニメファン１
text:
買えなんて言ってねーし
布教用、余ってるからあげるっつの
trans:
I'm not asking you to buy it.
I have extra copies to share, so I'll give you 
one.

name: アニメファン２
text:
だから先に言えっての！
神すぎだろ、助かるわ
trans:
I told you to tell me sooner!
You're an absolute legend, thanks.

name: off
text: ……そんな可愛いなら、アイドルにでもなれば？
trans:
... If you think you're that cute, why not 
become an idol or something?

name: off
text:
そっち側でもいけそうだよね、全然
黛さんだったら
trans:
If it's Mayuzumi-san, she could really make
it work on the other side of the runway.

name: off
text:
ふゆちゃんなら、きっとなれるよ
アイドル！
trans:
Fuyu-chan, you could totally pull off
being an idol!

name: 冬優子
text: 何くだらないこと考えてんだか
trans:
What am I doing, thinking of such
nonsense?
